description:
Commemoration of the day from the project's list of saints (rank, grc, short note, example for agents). It is NOT the liturgical celebration that governs the day: for that use liturgical_calendar (celebration) or mass_of_the_day. rank = the saint's rank (solemnity, feast, memorial, optional_memorial, traditional = not in the General Roman Calendar, kept by tradition); grc = true if the saint is in the General Roman Calendar.
ES: Conmemoración del día según la lista de santos del proyecto (rank, grc, nota y ejemplo para agentes). No es la celebración litúrgica que rige el día: esa está en liturgical_calendar o mass_of_the_day.

date.description: Date YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for today in Europe/Berlin; any other value (today, hoy, 2026/11/08, empty) is an error / Fecha AAAA-MM-DD; sin fecha, hoy en Berlín
